answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 50309 Country: INDIA Title: Mustamal water Question: If ghusl becomes obligatory and she takes ghusl from a bucket of water, will the water become mustamal even if hands are washed before putting it into the bucket? I have read that the water becomes mustamal only when the hands are not washed before putting it into the bucket. Answer ID: 50309 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 510/405/B=04/1435) No, this water does not turn used up (musta’mal), only the water which is used with the intention of wudhu or ghusl or removal of hadath (impurity) becomes musta’mal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
